props.custom_logic_resolution:
const DEBUG = true;

const TAG = "[CL-RES][CognitiveFocus]";

const ICON_URL = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Skill%20Icon/Elsword/Add/OvermindMaster1.png";

const STATUS_ID = "oni-cognitive-focus";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

if (DEBUG) console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "");

const casterActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

const casterTokenUuid = attackerDoc?.document?.uuid ?? attackerDoc?.uuid ?? "";

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p?.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? "";

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

if (DEBUG) console.warn(TAG, "No target found.");

return;

}

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

const targetTokenUuid = targetDoc?.document?.uuid ?? targetDoc?.uuid ?? "";

if (!casterActor || !targetActor) {

if (DEBUG) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing caster or target.", {

caster: casterActor?.name ?? null,

target: targetActor?.name ?? null

});

}

return;

}

const cognitiveFocusItem = casterActor.items.find(i => i.name === "Cognitive Focus");

const skillLevel = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(cognitiveFocusItem?.system?.props?.level ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

// Register visible token status icon once

if (!CONFIG.statusEffects.some(se => se.id === STATUS_ID)) {

CONFIG.statusEffects.push({

id: STATUS_ID,

name: "Focus",

img: ICON_URL

});

}

// Remove previous Focus from THIS same caster on this target

const previousFocus = targetActor.effects.filter(e =>

e.name === "Focus" &&

String(e.getFlag("oni", "cognitiveFocus")?.casterActorId ?? "") === String(casterActor.id)

);

if (previousFocus.length > 0) {

await targetActor.deleteEmbeddedDocuments(

"ActiveEffect",

previousFocus.map(e => e.id)

);

}

const effectData = {

name: "Focus",

img: ICON_URL,

description: `Focus applied by ${casterActor.name}. Removed at the start of ${casterActor.name}'s next turn.`,

disabled: false,

changes: [],

statuses: [STATUS_ID],

duration: {},

flags: {

oni: {

cognitiveFocus: {

active: true,

sourceSkill: "Cognitive Focus",

casterActorId: casterActor.id,

casterTokenUuid,

targetTokenUuid,

skillLevel,

appliedAt: Date.now()

}

}

}

};

const [effect] = await targetActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

if (DEBUG) {

console.log(TAG, "Focus applied.", {

caster: casterActor.name,

target: targetActor.name,

skillLevel,

effectId: effect?.id

});

}

// Auto-remove at the START of the caster's NEXT turn

const combat = game.combat;

const casterCombatant = combat?.combatants?.find(c => c.actor?.id === casterActor.id) ?? null;

const casterCombatantId = casterCombatant?.id ?? null;

if (!combat || !casterCombatantId) {

if (DEBUG) {

console.log(TAG, "No combat / no caster combatant. Focus applied without combat auto-removal hook.");

}

return;

}

let hasPassedAwayFromCaster = false;

let lastSeenKey = null;

const hookId = Hooks.on("updateCombat", async (updatedCombat, changed) => {

if (changed.turn === undefined) return;

if (typeof updatedCombat.turn !== "number") return;

const activeCombatantId = updatedCombat.combatant?.id ?? null;

const dedupeKey = `${updatedCombat.id}:${updatedCombat.round}:${updatedCombat.turn}:${activeCombatantId}`;

if (dedupeKey === lastSeenKey) return;

lastSeenKey = dedupeKey;

// Wait until combat has moved away from the caster at least once

if (activeCombatantId !== casterCombatantId) {

hasPassedAwayFromCaster = true;

if (DEBUG) {

console.log(TAG, "Turn moved away from caster. Waiting for caster next turn start.", {

activeCombatantId,

casterCombatantId

});

}

return;

}

// Ignore the current/original caster turn when the effect was first created

if (!hasPassedAwayFromCaster) {

if (DEBUG) {

console.log(TAG, "Still on original caster turn. Ignoring.");

}

return;

}

Hooks.off("updateCombat", hookId);

const liveEffect = targetActor.effects.get(effect.id);

if (liveEffect) {

await liveEffect.delete();

}

if (DEBUG) {

console.log(TAG, "Focus removed at start of caster next turn.", {

caster: casterActor.name,

target: targetActor.name

});

}

});
props.description:
At the start of your turn during a conflict, you may choose one ally who is able to hear you or one enemy you can see that is suffering from Dazed, Enraged, and/or Shaken. Until the start of your next turn, the chosen creature becomes your focus.

You gain a bonus equal to 【SL】 to Checks you perform to examine your focus, as well as to your Accuracy Checks and Magic Checks for 【⚔️Attack】 and 【⚡Offensive Spell】 that include your focus among the targets. When you cause your focus to recover Hit Points and/or Mind Points, they recover 【SL × 2】 additional HP and/or MP, respectively.
